# Why Can't G1 Simply Treat 'Power Cut' as an Emergency Stop During Walking?

> **Current answer:** Because bipedal stability depends on active control, direct power cut may result in uncontrolled fall and increase collision risk. This post only confirms the risk and links to research, without providing verified fixes; further design and validation of controlled deceleration, protective posture, braking, and isolation strategies are required.
